list.text: Hello! Have you been watching television?
Everything that's on TV is really cool!
You have to watch it to be popular!
It's good to have plenty of Pokémon, so when one is tired you can use another.
This city has exits in all directions.
That's why there are so many different people here.
"Jogue por diversão!" \n Mauville Game Corner.
The bike salesman here is a nice guy.
But he didn't give me any discount...
Mauville City Pokémon Gym Leader: Wattson\n"The cheerfully electrifying man!"
Mauville City \n " A brilhante cidade da diversão."
\f[faceDiane]\rSince you are visiting various places, I’d like to ask if, by any chance, you’ve heard anything about Butler...
\f[faceDiane]\rI'm looking for him.\nHe disappeared a few days ago; he seemed to be after something...
\f[faceButler]\bDiane!
\f[faceDiane]\rButler!
\f[faceDiane]\rI was looking for you!
\f[faceButler]\bI think I found it! I found it!
\f[faceButler]\bCome with me!
\f[faceDiane]\rErr... Sorry to bother you.\nYou can forget what I said.
\f[faceDiane]\rButler is impulsive sometimes...
\f[faceDiane]\rBefore I leave, please take this.
\f[faceDiane]\rWith this you can take the Cable Car on Route 112.
\f[faceDiane]\rWe still have time until the Millennium Comet appears, so I suggest you keep going with your Gym Challenge.
\f[faceDiane]\rI'll let you know once we have any news.\nBye!
